notes.title: Honey, where's my pants?
notes.content:
Lots of action is currently happening in the land of Superstore Rush, tons of new content to share. But first off, if you aren't on my [url=https://www.shantek.co/discord]Discord[/url]? Why? But seriously, you can find all the latest and greatest news on everything I'm cooking up for the game!

With that out of the way, work is underway on the final level design for the game! What are some of the things you can expect I hear you ask? I got you!

[h3]Rough block-out of the music department[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969700/a14cd42b3152fdf8b256abfe9a02516f7c861fff.png[/img]

[h3]Sporting department[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969700/6a2adb025b76aac68433ef3a14a1c862236c6bb4.png[/img]

[h3]The clothing department[/h3]

And of course the real reason you're here - we found the pants.. Most of the shelves have been created and are ready to use in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969700/411ab8a71bae40655ef3785ebbad266690dfadac.png[/img]

[h3]Tech department[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969700/ab3ed307c5eabb3a66952df1df7f1aac878faf09.png[/img]


Most of these new departments have been blocked out and are ready for the shelving states to be created ready to include in the game. Things are getting much closer to being complete ready for early access.

Still lots more I plan to add to the game over time so watch this space for more updates coming soon!

I'll leave you with a few final screenshots of the level in its current state. Enjoy!

notes.title: SuperstoreRush.com launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969700/9fe015f2581441916ff88653f34505220162e966.png[/img]

A new home has been created for Superstore Rush! You can check it out at [url=https://www.superstorerush.com]SuperstoreRush.com[/url].

This will be a great source of information for prior and upcoming changes to the game, however the most important part is the playable web builds directly on the website! You'll find the most up to date builds of the game available to play now on the website - but keep in mind these are dev builds and there's still a lot of content to add to wrap things up.

So what are you waiting for? Go have a taste of the game! Take note of your cloud key on the main menu as you can use this on the Steam build as soon as I release and it will sync your game progress, so a great opportunity to get a head start on your Superstore!

Have any feedback? Head to the [url=https://www.shantek.co/discord]Discord[/url] to let me know.

notes.title: Fire extinguishers and fire hazards added to Superstore Rush
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969700/fa2b9db61db6605de58e02fa3f52aede15b76756.png[/img]

Full steam ahead on the development of Superstore Rush with hazard types being added - Fires. Don't let your superstore burn down! This adds to the existing Spills hazard with a few more still planned (things like checkouts breaking down, rubbish maintenance etc.)

Things are getting much closer to being wrapped up, a few more departments are planned (clothing and electronics) to join the produce, grocery and deli departments.

Have ideas for hazards or departments you'd like to see added? I'd love to hear them. Be sure to jump on the [url=https://www.shantek.co/discord]community Discord server[/url].

Stay tuned for further updates!
